Gap Inc (NYSE:GPS) files its latest 10-K with SEC for the fiscal year ended on January 31, 2018. Gap Inc is a global apparel and accessories retailer. The company offers products for men, women, and children under various brands such as Gap, Banana Republic, Old Navy, Athleta, and Intermix. Gap Inc has a market cap of $12.55 billion; its shares were traded at around $32.28 with a P/E ratio of 15.10 and P/S ratio of 0.82. The dividend yield of Gap Inc stocks is 2.84%. Gap Inc had annual average EBITDA growth of 6.80% over the past ten years. 
For the last quarter Gap Inc reported a revenue of $4.8 billion, compared with the revenue of $4.4 billion during the same period a year ago. For the latest fiscal year the company reported a revenue of $15.9 billion, an increase of 2.2% from last year. For the last five years Gap Inc had an average revenue decline of 0.3% a year. 
The reported diluted earnings per share was $2.14 for the year, an increase of 26.6% from previous year. Over the last five years Gap Inc had an average EPS decline of 5.9% a year. The Gap Inc had an operating margin of 9.33%, compared with the operating margin of 7.68% a year before. The 10-year historical median operating margin of Gap Inc is 11.54%. The profitability rank of the company is 8 (out of 10). 
At the end of the fiscal year, Gap Inc has the cash and cash equivalents of $1.8 billion, compared with $1.8 billion in the previous year. The long term debt was $1.2 billion, compared with $1.2 billion in the previous year. Gap Inc has a financial strength rank of 7 (out of 10). 
At the current stock price of $32.28, Gap Inc is traded at 13.5% discount to its historical median P/S valuation band of $37.31. The P/S ratio of the stock is 0.82, while the historical median P/S ratio is 0.93. The stock gained 37.55% during the past 12 months.
